purpose: Create one new unsaved blank SpaceClaim design without overwriting the user's active document.
trigger: Use when a no-baseline execution requires a clean document entry state.
preconditions: The session is unique, authorized, idle, and free of a blocking dialog.
No-baseline entry and non-overwrite policy are declared.

outputs.name: document_state
outputs.description: Observed new-document state, unsaved status, and active-session identity; this atom does not inspect entity counts.

outputs.name: document_identity
outputs.description: Stable identity for the new active unsaved document.

postconditions: A new unsaved document is active and ready to receive a script.
The previous user document remains untouched; no geometry or native file is created.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. This establishes entry state only; body-count validation is not bundled.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The action could overwrite or discard user work.
failure_modes.detection: Active document is modified and safe transition is not confirmed.

failure_modes.condition: The new document is not confirmed active and unsaved.
failure_modes.detection: Title, marker, or identity remains ambiguous.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not load or run a script.

recovery.action: Obtain a safe new-document entry or baseline-copy policy.
Return needs_manual_review and restart only after entry is known.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: A new unsaved document is active and ready to receive a script.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
